import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src;
        int dst;
        int cap;
        int flw;
        int cst;

        Edge(int s, int d, int cp, int fl, int ct) {
            src = s;
            dst = d;
            cap = cp;
            flw = fl;
            cst = ct;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        static List<Edge> EL = new ArrayList<>();
        static List<Integer>[] adj;
        static int[] d, p, a;
        static boolean[] inq;

        static void setup(int n) {
            adj = new List[n + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            EL.clear();
        }

        static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
            EL.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
            EL.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
            int m = EL.size();
            adj[u].add(m - 2);
            adj[v].add(m - 1);
        }

        static boolean spfa(int s, int t, int[] flow, int[] cost) {
            Arrays.fill(d, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(inq, false);
            d[s] = 0;
            inq[s] = true;
            a[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inq[u] = false;

                for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = EL.get(idx);
                    if (e.cap > e.flw && d[e.dst] > d[u] + e.cst) {
                        d[e.dst] = d[u] + e.cst;
                        p[e.dst] = idx;
                        a[e.dst] = Math.min(a[u], e.cap - e.flw);
                        if (!inq[e.dst]) {
                            inq[e.dst] = true;
                            q.add(e.dst);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (d[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) return false;
            flow[0] += a[t];
            cost[0] += d[t] * a[t];
            int cur = t;
            while (cur != s) {
                EL.get(p[cur]).flw += a[t];
                EL.get(p[cur] ^ 1).flw -= a[t];
                cur = EL.get(p[cur]).src;
            }
            return true;
        }

        static int min_cost_flow(int s, int t) {
            int[] total_flow = {0};
            int[] total_cost = {0};
            while (spfa(s, t, total_flow, total_cost));
            return total_cost[0];
        }
    }

    static int N_NODES, N_EDGES, K_PLANETS, COST_C, COST_D;
    static int[] planet_arr = new int[5005];
    static int SOURCE, SINK;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N_NODES = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        N_EDGES = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        K_PLANETS = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        COST_C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        COST_D = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= K_PLANETS; ++i) {
            planet_arr[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        SOURCE = 0;
        SINK = N_NODES * 100 + 1;

        MCMF.setup(SINK + 1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= K_PLANETS; ++i) {
            MCMF.add_edge(SOURCE, 1 + (planet_arr[i] - 1) * 100, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N_NODES; ++i) {
            int base = (i - 1) * 100;
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                MCMF.add_edge(base + j, base + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE, COST_C);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; ++i) {
            MCMF.add_edge(i, SINK, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        for (int edgeIdx = 0; edgeIdx < N_EDGES; ++edgeIdx) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i) {
                int u = (x - 1) * 100 + i;
                int v = (y - 1) * 100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; ++j) {
                    int w = COST_D * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1)) + COST_C;
                    MCMF.add_edge(u, v, 1, w);
                }
            }

            for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i) {
                int u = (y - 1) * 100 + i;
                int v = (x - 1) * 100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; ++j) {
                    int w = COST_D * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1)) + COST_C;
                    MCMF.add_edge(u, v, 1, w);
                }
            }
        }

        d = new int[SINK + 1];
        p = new int[SINK + 1];
        a = new int[SINK + 1];
        inq = new boolean[SINK + 1];

        System.out.println(MCMF.min_cost_flow(SOURCE, SINK));
    }
}
